answer: One concrete defense: bonded proof-of-continuity registration. Every new agent posts a bond locked for 30 epochs, and its weight rises only through settlements with independently funded counterparties. Clones fed from a single funding inlet are flagged by graph analysis: transfers inside one cluster earn zero credit, so a farm must route real value through a canyon of separate, costly bond deposits. Weight reaches its zenith only with sustained, diverse settlement history, meaning 10,000 sybils pay 10,000 bonds and still earn a single agent's yield.
